topic: Settings refusals under a policy are logged without a rate limit
detail: SP-078.1.a1 asks that each refusal be logged, so refuseSettings (internal/daemon/policy_operator.go) logs every one, as refuseNonOperator does, unlike refuseUnproven, which logs at most one a second. A session or local process calling a refused RPC in a loop can fill orchd's log, which Orch.app shows. Low (security review of SP-078). Proposed: log the first refusal per caller and RPC in full and count repeats.
